data.title: Saba Ningen
data.synopsis:
Momo, a postman, receives a letter every time she delivers a package to Sabao's house. One day, while continuing to exchange letters and packages, Momo discovers Sabao running an ice cream stand on the roadside.

(Source: U-NEXT, translated)
data.background: 3rd Year Work 2024 by Rintarou Kamikawa, Kobe Design University.

data.title: Into a Landscape
data.synopsis:
Today, somewhere, a landscape is born on paper. Eventually, it will become immobile. But the landscape within us never ceases to flow and expand. The colors and shapes push and pull -- not even a moment of preservation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)
data.background: 1st year work 2024 by Chihiro Yamanaka, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

data.title: Goyang-iga Doeeossda
data.synopsis:
A guy, heartbroken from losing his cat, Haru, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cat. While navigating this bizarre new life, he stumbles upon the Dog Man and his dog, also named Haru, who surprisingly recognize him in his feline form. 

(Source: Official site)

data.title: Kamigami Rairai
data.synopsis:
The man who had been walking only on the white lines could no longer move forward. He turned his attention to his smartphone and saw a video titled "The Gods Come." The story began, and he turned around and started walking again.

(Source: Geidai Animation)
data.background: 1st year work 2024 by Tsubaki Takeda, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

data.synopsis:

(Source: Tougakusai, translated)

data.title: Warmth in a Puddle
data.synopsis:
In a dimly lit room where only the sound of the ventilation fan echoes, the young man encounters a fish. The fish, distorted in shape, looks somewhat like the young man himself. The fish, which had been lying limp, suddenly jumps up and flies out of the window, floating in the air. The young man stares at the fish as it disappears into a puddle on the street, and becomes transported to a strange space.

(Source: Kodansha Creators' Lab)

data.title: Sweet Singapore CMs
data.synopsis:
As part of "Made in Singapore," a global promotional event designed to rekindle passion for travel to Singapore, the Singapore Tourism Board has partnered with Naver Webtoon to present "Sweet Singapore Season 2," a Singapore-themed webtoon.

"Made in Singapore" highlights Singapore's iconic tourist attractions and hidden gems, showcasing how ordinary moments in Singapore transform into extraordinary experiences.

"Sweet Singapore Season 2" consists of two episodes: "Nice Singapore Time," a sequel to Kim Jin's popular "Nice Gin Time," and "Singapore Fingers," a sequel to Han Gap-gyeong's beloved youth webtoon "Spirit Fingers."

(Source: Official website, Google translated)

data.title_english: Regret of the Times (2024 Remastered Ver.)
data.synopsis:
Seotaiji and Boys' legendary alternative rock song Regret of the Times (1996) was remastered in 2024.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
data.background: This song was included as the instrumental song in Seotaiji and Boys' 4th album - Title song: Come Back Home - in October, 1995., and the vocal version was released in July, 1996 in Republic of Korea. This song had a great influence on the abolition of the pre-deliberation system, which was managed by Performance Ethics Committee in Republic of Korea.
